scope: Stationary geometry screen only; not pressure decomposition, jetting or thermal qualification. Region boundary follows each cone top.

limitations: Midplane estimates integrate cell-centred J on the first nonnegative coordinate plane of current_report_axis. The +/-2 mm mean includes the full interval even where a phase is absent; it is not a unique through-current.
Ideal electrical contact; material and oxide/contact resistance require bracketing.

body mode makes whole terminal bodies equipotential. x-ends supplies the outermost modeled x-plane of each copper pad and resolves copper resistance only inside the electrical domain; out-of-domain leads remain separate.
Static liquid; no moving interface, motional EMF, self-field, driver, thermal evolution or droplet claim.
Applied magnetization and unit permeability approximate a specified magnet grade; check local field and temperature.
native.power_definition: sum terminal phi*I on both ports
native.status: cold DC conduction and applied permanent-magnet field only; no ejection simulation
